title: coons_extrude_mesh: curve-preserving extrude for bezier cages
description: Companion to DSL-42. Extrude_mesh variant that places top-face corners using per-vertex Coons surface normals (∂S/∂u × ∂S/∂v averaged across incident cage faces) rather than the cage face-normal approximation. Top-face edge handles copy from the bottom face edges (translation preserves tangent direction). Side-wall vertical edges get zero handles (straight extrusion). region=true supported. Fail-loud when input lacks handles. Pairs with coons_inset_faces for the cage-first workflow without cheese-grater.
definition-of-done: 1. coons_extrude_mesh node registered. 2. Top-face vertices at coons_surface(corner) + offset * coons_surface_normal(corner). 3. Handles correctly copy between top and bottom parallel edges. 4. Watertight under chained coons_inset + coons_extrude. 5. Visibly cleaner than plain extrude_mesh at high handle weight.
testing-plan: 1. cube + handles + coons_inset + coons_extrude(selection=inset.generated) + coons_patch + merge - watertight with clean depressions. 2. Same with region=true for multi-face selections.
